title: Count unlabeled natural-sample items as missing coverage
description: Current read-only reviews split report says natural_mix n300,sme_labeled0,no_label0 when none of the300 natural IDs have cached labels. This wrongly hides missing coverage. As an evaluator I need no_label to include every expected natural-sample item without a valid label, including absent cache records, not just ambiguous returned records. Adjacent regression must fail first on empty/partial cache, then pass with natural_size-minus-valid-label coverage and explicit missing/ambiguous counts. No private texts or paid calls; preserve existing labeled mix and heldout partitions.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Verified regression: empty natural SME cache now reports 300 missing labels, rather than zero. Partial coverage separates uncached, ambiguous, rejected. Adjacent specs: 15 passed. No private inputs or split membership changed.
